notes:
POC notes: Hosted API POC (3w) - used gpt-like open model in Redwood catalog for search+summaries. Results: median p95 latency 120ms for chat, embeddings eval ok but cost > target. Customer quote: 'Hosted latency is great, but we'll need predictable $/token for scale.'

Dedicated ask: mid-market predictable pricing + ability to burst during product launches. They want 12-month commit with staged ramp (Q1 small, Q2 ramp x2, Q3 full traffic). Key asks:
- Commit tiers: prefer 3 options: Starter (4 reserved GPUs equiv), Growth (8), Production (12)
- Burst: guaranteed burst to +2x baseline for 2 hours/day during launches, ability to request scheduled bursts
- Overage: 150% of committed rate per unit for on-demand; pref cap for top-end months
- Ramp schedule: month-by-month ramp in term sheet (30% of commit first 2 months, 60% months 3-6, 100% month 7+)
use_case_summary: Product team needs low-latency, high-throughput chat and document search for in-app support and automated summaries. High concurrency during product releases; embeddings used to rank knowledge base articles. Sensitive PII flows in logs; requires audit trails and optional KMS encryption for keys.
pricing_preferences: Customer prefers commit expressed as reserved GPU units and token throughput. Asking for volume discount bands at 6k, 12k, 24k token-credits/day equivalents. Interested in ramp credits (first 3 months discounted), and a predictable monthly overage formula rather than spot pricing.
legal_security_status: Security questionnaire submitted 2026-02-18. Need SOC2 report and DPA redlines. Sec team raised one data residency Q (EU regulatory customers - they may require region residency later). KMS integration call scheduled.
po_notes: AE proposed: 12-month contract, Growth tier (8 reserved GPU-eq), burst pool + scheduled bursts, 10% commitment discount, sliding overage at 1.4x committed unit price after crossing 110% of monthly commit. Customer asked for 30-day review window after go-live to adjust commit. Internal pricing suggested INF discount band and legal to evaluate DPA redlines.
